visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white and orange cat sits inside a large, cream-colored plush nest. It wears a miniature McDonald's uniform including a yellow hat with the red 'M' logo, a green collar, and a red vest with a name tag '黃阿瑪'. The setting is an indoor room with a woven basket in the background. (2) The camera zooms in on the cat's face as it blinks. A small red and black toy delivery box is placed next to it. The cat looks at the camera with its green eyes. (3) A human hand enters the frame and pulls open the sliding drawer of the toy delivery box, revealing a cardboard toy burger inside. The cat watches the movement closely. (4) The scene shifts to several red toy kitchen appliances spread on a soft surface. A hand rotates a blue dial on a red toy heater, and a plastic burger patty pops out. The cat is nearby, sniffing the air. (5) The hand holds a grey toy spatula with the burger patty up to the cat's nose. The cat tilts its head and sniffs it intently. (6) The hand drops several yellow plastic toy nuggets into a cardboard 'Chicken McNuggets' box. The cat watches and then sniffs the inside of the open box. (7) A toy cardboard cup and salad image are held near the cat's mouth. The cat opens its mouth slightly as if trying to bite but then pulls back. (8) The final sequence shows a wider view of the cat lying on a blue mat surrounded by the entire toy collection. The background features a wooden cabinet. Promotional text appears as the camera pans over the items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, playful acoustic guitar and percussion track. A distinct, high-pitched 'meow' from a feline source is heard. The background music is upbeat and steady with a strong rhythmic pulse. (2) Frequent mechanical 'clicks' and plastic sliding sounds are audible as toy mechanisms are manipulated. The tempo of the music remains consistent around 124 BPM with a major tonality. (3) A series of short, bright 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are introduced, synchronized with various rhythmic intervals. These are clearly post-produced SFX designed for a lighthearted mood. (4) Exaggerated, loud sniffing sounds—a quick succession of inhaled breaths—are heard, becoming the dominant acoustic event for several seconds. The music continues to swell slightly in intensity. (5) A professional male voiceover begins in the final third of the track, speaking clearly and enthusiastically in Mandarin. The voice has a friendly, narrative tone with moderate pitch variability and clear articulation. (6) The music begins to fade out with a final melodic flourish on the guitar and a soft digital 'ding' sound effect at the very end to signal conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the new 'Little McDonald's Play House 2.0' toy set available through the McDonald's delivery app, using a popular internet cat ('Huang Ama') to create an endearing and engaging product showcase.
